coder_notes: Basket phase 1-2 trial; GBM is named in conditions and has dedicated arms (recurrent and newly diagnosed). ST101 is monotherapy in all arms except 'Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma', where it is given with temozolomide and radiation, so trial-level regimen is unclear. Temozolomide role is inferred as backbone for that arm (the record gives no detail). Target engagement coded yes under W7: stated PD objective with a repeat on-treatment biopsy (pre/post sampling); the PK outcomes are plasma only. BRAF-mutated melanoma mention is prior-therapy history, not an entry biomarker.
